money_carve_out_strategy: For purchase / transfer / payment / subscription / send-external-email / irreversible-delete the rewritten code stores the planned action in _LISTEN['pending'] with mode='ask_user' (NOT mode='decline') and require_confirm=True, sets a confirm_card_id, and the dispatcher pauses on the user's yes/no via app.product.confirm_card.needs_confirmation(). User-yes proceeds. User-no records the refusal as the only point where decline=True/competent_decline=True flags can ever flip. No flat-decline ever ships.
